__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: InfluxDB instance fed by Telegraf's mqtt_consumer subscribed to sovd/+/events and sovd/+/telemetry (see monitoring/telegraf/sovd_mqtt_input.conf.example)

panels.title: Session / Lock Timeline
panels.description: Every lock_acquired / lock_released / lock_release_mismatch event, most recent first -- who held which entity's session and when.

targets.query: SELECT event, entity, lock_id, correlation_id FROM sovd_events WHERE event =~ /^lock_acquired$|^lock_released$|^lock_release_mismatch$/ AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Lock Contention by Entity
panels.description: Count of lock_denied (another tester already holds the lock) per entity -- high counts point at contention or a misbehaving client retrying a 423.

targets.query: SELECT count("correlation_id") FROM sovd_events WHERE event = 'lock_denied' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY entity

panels.title: Auth Failure Rate (lock_denied + lock_release_mismatch)
panels.description: lock_release_mismatch (wrong lock_id on release) and repeated lock_denied are the two CLAUDE.md alert signatures for this phase -- a probing or misbehaving client.

targets.query: SELECT count("correlation_id") FROM sovd_events WHERE event =~ /^lock_denied$|^lock_release_mismatch$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
